text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival. 
Every corner of Tracen Academy is bustling 
with excitement.
Meanwhile, out on the training track—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The quiz Gold Ship-san is taking, "What's 
That Sound!?", has only 3 questions left!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep going!! Here comes the 
question!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what kind of sound it is! 
Come at me!!
(――*plop*)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's simple! —The sound of a tadpole 
splashing across the water!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What...!? That is correct!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was at lightning speed! Let's keep 
the momentum going! Next question!!
(—Slurp)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ho... So that's your angle.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Piece of cake! —The sound of morning dew 
wetting the green grass!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Once again, an instant correct 
answer!! What incredible dominance from 
Golshi-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I wouldn't mind if it was even 
harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What reassuring words! That said, the next 
one is our final question!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Get it right and you'll receive a 
championship belt! Now, here is the 
question!!
(Tock, tock, tock...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? This is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she looks like she's hesitating! Is 
this even too tough for Golshi-san?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: No—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That ain't it. The sound itself is simple. 
It's gotta be a wooden fish gong. No doubt 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What I'm curious about... is their 
vitality.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: V-Vitality...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Every sound so far was full of life. 
It felt truly "alive."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...However, this wooden fish is different.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Life, strength, passion, the feeling of 
truly being alive... I can't feel a damn 
thing...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's bone dry, just like a withered piece 
of wood...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you stagehand bastards!! Are you 
half-assing those drum beats or what!?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't screw with me! Don't look down on 
the wooden fish!! Put some real life into 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you play with full passion, even a 
wooden fish will start swimming in the 
water, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Umm... This is the quiz corner... right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Did things just take a weird turn? Is 
this... part of the show?

This isn't an act... Gold Ship is probably 
genuinely furious!! —About how the wooden 
fish is being treated!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Forget the quiz, call it off, call it 
offff!! Cancel it right this instant!!" 
any

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, bring me a wooden temple 
block right now!! I'll play it with my 
raging passion!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: W-Wait... WHAAAAAAAAAT?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
AWWW YEAAAAAHHH!! Time for the wooden fish 
live to begiiiiin!!

Standing before the wooden temple block, 
Gold Ship moved with wild intensity—

With such magnificent drumstick work, the 
wooden fish is thumping wildly like a 
beating heart!!

It looks like it could swim right away if 
you put it in water...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I-Is that Gold Ship...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I heard she was extraordinary, but to this 
extent...!

Whether they're captivated by Gold Ship's 
bizarre performance or simply 
overwhelmed...

In any case, the surrounding area was 
engulfed in an extraordinary fever 
pitch...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm not done yet!! C'mon!!

The passionate performance continued after 
that, occasionally featuring 
call-and-response moments—

Later on, it surprisingly received high 
praise, with people saying, "I don't 
really get it, but it was hilarious."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible, Gold Ship...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, in a split second, she completely 
made this whole space her own...!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? That sound... could it be a wooden 
temple block!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-What incredible intensity! Caught up in 
the moment, my virtue is soaring toooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hannyaka, funnyaka, honjarage~!! Lotus 
root, offset, spinach~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Sounds like a nice rhythm coming 
from the audience—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah, it's suuuuuper lively here, isn't 
it~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm joining in on air guitar 
tooo~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru, Ticket-zo...!! You guys...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You've got some serious passion!! Come on 
down here, damn it!!!! Let's start a band 
together!!!!

Afterward, the course echoed with the 
sounds of a wooden fish, chanted spells, 
and air guitar—

From the stands, the 'temple block chants' 
echoed without end.

Before long, this event would be passed 
down at the academy as the legendary 
"One-Day-Only Wooden Fish Live."
